newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TESTING NIGHT FOR RETURNING SACCHI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TESTING NIGHT FOR RETURNING SACCHI.

text.p: Arrigo Sacchi faces an immediate test of nerve on his return to AC Milan as they fight for their Champions League future at home to Norwegian side Rosenborg on Wednesday.
The two sides are chasing one place in the quarter-finals and, although Milan only need a draw to progress, Sacchi acknowledges the Italian champions currently have problems.

Milan are in 10th position in the league and last week were eliminated from the Italian Cup by league leaders Vicenza. Sunday's 3-2 defeat to Piacenza which prompted the departure of Uruguayan Oscar Washington Tabarez was their seventh in 22 competitive games this season.

"It won't be easy to get out of this situation and to do so it's essential that everybody is frank and self-critical," said Sacchi, back at the club where he won a league title and two Champions Cups between 1987 and 1991 when he left to take charge of Italy.
"This side clearly has a wealth of technique and talent but we have to find out why that talent is not imposing itself. It can't just be the fault of the coach".

Sacchi's immediate problems against Rosenborg concern the suspension-enforced absence of three key players - Liberian striker George Weah, French midfielder Marcel Desailly and midfielder Stefano Eranio.
Sacchi may field an unusual attack of Roberto Baggio, Montenegrin Dejan Savicevic and Frenchman Christophe Dugarry, scorer of Milan's two goals against Piacenza.
Milan face further problems in midfield where Dutchman Edgar Davids is ruled out with a broken hand and both Demetrio Albertini and Zvonimir Boban are doubtful starters.
Rosenborg coach Nils Arne Eggen, however, does not believe his side will gain any advantage from Milan's weekend change of coach.

"There won't be any advantage in it for us. The new coach can certainly help Milan at a difficult moment but after just two days in charge and in just one game, Sacchi will not be able to make that big a difference.
"As far as we're concerned, we'll just have to play our best to try and beat Milan"

Eggen is likely to field a three-man attack of Harald Brattbakk, Vegard Heggem and Steffen Iversen, in his last match before joining Tottenham Hotspur, with Jahn Jakobsen on standby to come on as a second half substitute.

Probable teams: AC Milan - Sebastiano Ross; Christian Panucci, Alessandro Costacurta, Franco Baresi, Paolo Maldini; Tomas Locatelli, Massimo Ambrosini, Demetrio Albertini, Roberto Baggio; Dejan Savicevic, Christophe Dugarry. Rosenborg - Jorn Jamtfall; Bjorn Kvarme, Jan Hjelde, Erik Hoftun, Stale Stensaas ; Bent Skammelsrud, Trend Soltvedt, Roar Strand; Harald Brattbakk, Vegard Heggem, Steffen Iversen.
